name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
briefDescription: "CMST: Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the Students with Disability who are a domicile of the State of Manipur, and are studying in Class 1st and and above are awarded with scholarship of upto ₹ 8,000/-.
descriptionMd: "Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the Students with Disability (SwD) who are a domicile of the State of Manipur, and are studying in Class 1st and above are awarded with scholarship of upto ₹ 8,000/-. The student must be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Govt. of Manipur. The amount of the scholarhip shall be disbursed directly into the bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (PwD). 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be a domicile of the State of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st and above. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Govt. of Manipur. 1. The applicant should not be availing scholarship under any other similar scheme from any source.
